videos.title: They Are Making You Doubt Your Own Reality
videos.description:
They Are Making You Doubt Your Own Reality

You remember the conversation perfectly, but they swear it never happened. You are not forgetting things. You are experiencing calculated psychological gaslighting. They alter tiny details, deny past statements, and stay perfectly calm while you panic. Your brain hates friction, so it slowly accepts their rewritten narrative. Eventually, you stop trusting your own eyes and start trusting their voice. To break the trap, document reality immediately. Never let someone else rewrite what you experienced.

videos.title: Why You Are Playing Not To Lose
videos.description:
Why You Are Playing Not To Lose

Losing a hundred dollars hurts twice as much as finding it. Psychologists call this loss aversion. Evolution prioritized survival over reward. Missing lunch meant hunger, but missing a predator meant death. Today, that exact fear keeps you trapped. You stay in miserable situations just to avoid the unknown. You aren't actually playing to win. You are merely playing not to lose. Stop protecting what bores you and start taking real risks.
